name: Eugard Vollachia
japaneseName: ユーガルド・ヴォラキア
description: Eugard Vollachia was the sixty-first emperor of the Sacred Vollachia Empire and the lover of Iris (Yorna Mishigure). Known as the 'King of Thorns', he was the titular figure of 'Iris and the King of Thorns' and played an antagonistic and supportive role upon resurrection in Arc 8.
